moveEffects.name: Swift
moveEffects.originalDescription: Has the user shoots 6 star-shaped rays in the designated direction, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon hit and reducing their movement speed by 35% for 0.3s. The user is slowed by 30% while casting this move. The slow duration is extended by 0.3s for each star that hits the same Pokémon.

uniteMoveEffects.name: Aquamarine Splash
uniteMoveEffects.originalDescription: Has the user jump up high and dive underwater, creating a current that pulls in nearby opposing Pokémon for 0.3s. Afterward, the user leaps out of the water, dealing damage to nearby opposing Pokémon and throws them for 1s. Unite buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 40% Max HP Shield
